aliases: Contents of the context of assessment
Physical setting, tools, materials and purpose of assessment

one_line_answer.text: The context of assessment includes physical setting, tools, materials and purpose of assessment.

cites.quote: The context of assessment includes the following:

keywords.bn: যে উপকরণ ব্যবহারে শেষ হয়ে যায়

bangla_explanation: Context of assessment মানে কোন পরিবেশে assessment হবে।
এতে চারটি বিষয় থাকে: physical setting, tools ও equipment, materials আর purpose।
Assessment শুরুর আগেই tools আর materials ready রাখা assessor-এর দায়িত্ব।
Purpose দুজনের কাছেই পরিষ্কার থাকতে হবে, assessor আর assessee।

example.en: Before a bakery assessment, the assessor checks the oven, flour and venue. He tells candidates it is for certification.
example.bn: বেকারি assessment-এর আগে oven, ময়দা আর ভেন্যু ঠিক আছে কি না দেখা হয়।

items.text: Physical setting: the workplace, an assessment center, community project or online set-up.

cites.quote: Physical Setting. This may be the workplace, an assessment center, community project or online set-up.

items.text: Tools, equipment and facilities: ready and available before the assessment starts.

cites.quote: ready and available before the assessment start.

items.text: Materials: the candidate must have access to perishable and consumable materials.

cites.quote: The candidate must have access to perishable and consumable materials required during the assessment.

items.text: Purpose of assessment: clear to both the assessor and the assessee.

cites.quote: The purpose of the assessment must be clear to both the assessor and the assessee.

traps.text: A venue for assessment should be accessible to the candidates.

cites.quote: A venue for assessment should be made accessible to the candidates for their convenience.

traps.text: The purpose must be clear to both the assessor and the assessee, not only one.

cites.quote: The purpose of the assessment must be clear to both the assessor and the assessee.

short.prompt: What does the context of assessment include?
short.modelAnswer:
The context of assessment is the setting where assessment takes place. It includes:
1. Physical setting: workplace, assessment center, community project or online set-up.
2. Tools, equipment and facilities, ready before the assessment.
3. Materials: perishable and consumable materials for the candidate.
4. Purpose of assessment: clear to both assessor and assessee.

keyPoints.text: The assessment site should have the right equipment and be quiet enough to assess.

cites.quote: ensure that the assessment site is conducive for assessment i.e. has the right equipment is quiet enough to assess the candidates.

keyPoints.text: A checklist in the Competency Assessment Plan helps monitor tools, equipment and facilities.

cites.quote: The checklist of tools, equipment and facilities (in the Competency Assessment Plan) will help the assessor to monitor their availability

keyPoints.text: Be clear if the assessment is for certification, licensing, OSH or skills audit.

cites.quote: Ensure you one clear if the assessment is for certification, licensing, OSH or skills audit.

viva.prompt: Who must ensure tools and equipment are ready before assessment?

answer.text: The assessor. Tools, equipment and facilities must be ready before the assessment starts.

cites.quote: Part of the responsibility of the assessor is to ensure that the tools, equipment and facilities are ready and available before the assessment start.

checks.note: CBLM 11 p.8 lists four contents (physical setting; tools, equipment and facilities; materials; purpose). CBLM 12 card context-of-assessment lists a different three (environment, relationship to real work, time period). The definition passage is linked to the CBLM 12 card. Decide which list learners should write for 'context of assessment includes'.
